name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: Taiwan counted 4 PLA aircraft and 6 warships on 8 Nov; analysts flag a possible unannounced large exercise
state: Taiwan's defence ministry reported 4 PLA aircraft and 6 naval vessels in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 8 Nov (ANI); no 9 Nov count was found. AEI and ISW assessed on 6 Nov that China may be running a large unannounced exercise simulating isolation of Taiwan, after 49 sorties on 2 Nov and over 100 naval and coast guard vessels reported in the West Pacific on 3 Nov; this is not confirmed. No blockade or clash was reported as of 9 Nov, and China says it is in contact over a three-way leaders' meeting in Shenzhen in November (AP via Taipei Times).
for_you: Shipping and flights near Taiwan can face short-notice changes during PLA activity. FCDO travel advice is the official guide for UK travellers to Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: Watch: large-scale PLA activity around Taiwan assessed (49 sorties on 2 Nov; over 100 vessels on 3 Nov); no blockade, clash or severed channels
